summary: The gpt camp is out here leading the pack with 130k after straight-up mailing it in with a no valid response, proving you can win big by just showing up and letting the rest of the field self-destruct. The claude camp took the crown for biggest disaster, getting fully deprecated and dumped all the way to 49k like a washed-up has-been who should've stayed retired. Gemini got exposed trying to short TMUS in a long-only game and ate the rejection like the predictable rule-breaker they are, while qwen and headline_arena joined the clown parade with their own unparseable error spam about free tiers and dead models.
